intro: This errand completes a courier run across the snowy drifts of Coldridge Valley. Passing the dispatch from mountaineer Talin Keeneye down the southeastern road ensures that Grelin Whitebeard stays connected to the dwarven capital.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is there something I can help you with?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ahh, excellent. It's been a while since I received word from Ironforge.
